ops.title: ccx pushes always pass --no-thin (PR #282)
ops.body: ccx vcs push v0.72.30 failed after a restack in the monorepo's blob:none partial clone with '[remote rejected] (missing necessary objects)'; raw push --no-thin with the same lease succeeded. Fix: pushArgv (internal/cli/ship.go) adds --no-thin, covering vcs push, ship git/gt lanes, stack submit/rebase/drop. Regression fixture: bare origin with receive.unpackLimit=1 and remote.origin.receivepack='git receive-pack --reject-thin-pack-for-testing' rejects thin packs (unpacker error). jj git push unchanged. Local jj/gt fixture tests fail on this Mac regardless (broken mise jj/gt shims; template 'git commit -qm init' exits 1).
